verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships its own background automations: Fred can auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe and summarize without user action, and a Rules Engine provides admin automation workflows. However, the Rules Engine is scoped to meeting access and privacy, and broader user-defined automations depend on webhooks or Zapier, which are building blocks or third-party tools and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose, user-configurable automation builder (custom triggers and actions) within Fireflies, detailed docs on configuring the Rules Engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended.
